enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Turn over. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Continue sleeping.

Wake up. Get out of bed. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.

Open refrigerator. Take out eggs, milk, butter. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Turn off stove. Take plate. Put eggs on plate. Sit at table. Eat eggs. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Put dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: doing laundry using washing machine and clothes dryer
enriched_activities.desc: Collect dirty clothes. Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine. Load clothes. Add detergent. Close washing machine. Press start button. Wait. Open washing machine. Take out clothes. Put clothes in dryer. Close dryer. Press start button. Wait. Open dryer. Take out clothes. Fold clothes. Put clothes away.

Pick up items from floor. Put items in place. Move furniture. Take vacuum cleaner. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Vacuum floor. Move to different areas. Vacuum under sofa. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Put vacuum away. Arrange cushions. Wipe table.
Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Watch TV. Adjust volume. Change channel. Stand up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return. Sit down. Continue watching TV. Turn off TV.

Open refrigerator. Take out bread, lettuce, ham. Close refrigerator. Take out knife. Cut bread. Spread mayonnaise. Add lettuce, ham. Close sandwich. Put sandwich on plate. Sit at table. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: reading and relaxing with air conditioner on
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on sofa. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Adjust air conditioner. Continue reading. Put book down. Stand up. Stretch. Sit down. Pick up book. Continue reading. Close book. Put book down.
Walk to bedroom. Turn on air conditioner. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Nap. Wake up. Turn off air conditioner. Get up. Walk out.

Pick up controller. Turn on game console. Turn on TV. Select game. Play game. Press buttons. Move controller. Pause game. Get drink. Resume game. Play game. Turn off game console. Turn off TV. Put controller down.
Pick up phone. Open music app. Select song. Play music. Adjust volume. Sit on sofa. Tap foot. Change song. Turn off music. Put phone down.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables, chicken. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Cut vegetables. Cut chicken. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add chicken. Cook chicken. Add vegetables. Stir. Turn off stove. Take plate. Put food on plate.
Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat food. Chew. Swallow. Drink water. Cut food. Eat more. Finish meal. Pick up plate. Walk to sink. Wash plate. Put plate away.
Sit on sofa. Turn on TV. Pick up laptop. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Type on keyboard. Watch TV. Switch to computer. Open browser. Scroll. Watch TV. Close laptop. Turn off TV. Stand up.
Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash hands. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face with towel. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out.
Walk to bedroom. Turn off light. Lie down on bed. Close eyes. Sleep. Adjust pillow. Pull blanket. Turn over. Continue sleeping.
